title: Body Plan
description: Definition of a kinematic tree with joints and degrees of freedom.

^x-.description: Reserved namespace for custom metadata/extension fields.

fixed_base.description: Whether the root joint is fixed in world space (true) or free-floating (false).

joints.description: Joints in the tree. The first joint with parent=null is the root; order should be such that a joint's parent appears earlier in the list.

^x-.description: Reserved namespace for custom metadata/extension fields.

parent.description: Name of the parent joint, or null for the root joint.

offset_pos.description: Translation offset from the parent joint frame.

offset_quat.description: Rotation offset from the parent joint frame, quaternion as [w, x, y, z].

weight_scaler.description: Scaling constant applied to weights for this joint's contribution in inverse kinematics.

dofs.description: Degrees of freedom defined at this joint, applied in order.

^x-.description: Reserved namespace for custom metadata/extension fields.

axis.description: Unit axis of rotation (hinge) or translation (slide), in the parent joint's local frame.

neutral.description: Neutral (rest) value of the DOF. Given in radians for hinge DOFs and the model's native unit for slide DOFs.

weight_scaler.description: Scaling constant applied to weights for this DOF's contribution to the natural pose preference term.

limits.description: [min, max] limits for the DOF, in radians for hinge DOFs and the model's native unit for slide DOFs. Use null for unbounded DOFs.
